raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: aiokafka
  version: "0.15.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8457e45565544c0888679943a0de2a284526d2ce489ad861f4b740f2f58b5dd0
  patches:
    # Regenerate platform-specific Cython sources instead of reusing Linux C files on Windows.
    - regenerate-cython-sources.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3.0.5
        - zlib
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - cython >=3.0.5
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    - if: match(python, "<3.12")
      then: typing-extensions >=4.6.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - aiokafka
        - aiokafka.record._crecords.cutil
        - aiokafka.record._crecords.default_records
        - aiokafka.record._crecords.legacy_records
        - aiokafka.record._crecords.memory_records
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: asyncio client for Kafka
  description: |
    AIOKafkaProducer is a high-level, asynchronous message producer.
  homepage: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiokafka
  repository: https://github.com/aio-libs/aiokafka

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - timkpaine

about.description: AIOKafkaProducer is a high-level, asynchronous message producer.
